text: dsh-share 是供 DSH Web 客户端使用的会话分享插件，可将当前会话生成为局域网可访问的只读快照。它在会话标题栏加入分享按钮，通过主机 RPC 读取会话事件并生成固定转录和统计信息，再由独立 HTTP 服务提供带随机令牌的页面。用户可以复制或打开链接、查看已有分享、撤销链接，并选择永不过期或 1 小时、24 小时、7 天有效期；页面呈现对话、工具调用和上下文统计。适合在同一局域网内向手机或其他设备展示 DSH 会话。无需 API 密钥；主机默认监听 0.0.0.0:3081，相关地址和端口可用环境变量调整。

dsh-share adds a Share button to DSH Web and creates a read-only transcript for local-network viewing. A separate server serves token links; users can list, copy, revoke, or set expiry. Pages show messages, tool calls, and session statistics. No API key is needed; it defaults to 0.0.0.0:3081.

I need a read-only web snapshot of a session that I can share on my local network.
dsh-share 的功能「创建会话快照」：点击会话标题栏的分享按钮并生成链接，主机读取当前事件记录，保存固定转录和统计页面。
dsh-share 的功能「管理分享链接」：在分享对话框列出已有链接，可复制、打开或撤销；创建时还能选择有效期。
dsh-share 的功能「浏览转录和统计」：打开令牌链接后查看用户与助手消息、工具调用，以及轮次、耗时、令牌和上下文分类统计。
dsh-share 的功能「格式化长对话」：分享页将消息按 Markdown 显示，长消息可展开，连续工具调用可折叠查看。
dsh-share 使用独立 HTTP 服务提供会话快照，默认绑定 0.0.0.0:3081；同一局域网内能访问令牌链接的设备可读取该快照。
@zljr/dsh-share README · Introduction：<div align="center">

@zljr/dsh-share README · dsh-share：**Share a DeepSeek Harness session over your LAN as a read-only, token-guarded snapshot.** [📖 中文文档](./README_CN.md) `dsh-share` is a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness) plugin that adds a **Share** button to the session header. One click freezes the current conversation into a self-contained, read-only HTML page and prints a LAN URL — e.g. `http://192.168.1.20:3081/s/` — that any device on the same network can open in a browser.

@zljr/dsh-share README · dsh-share：The main harness keeps listening on `127.0.0.1` (and so never exposes the agent's command execution). Sharing is served by a **separate, read-only HTTP server** that only ever returns a pre-rendered snapshot page for a valid token.

@zljr/dsh-share README · Features：- 🔗 **One-click share** — a **Share** button in the session header (beside the official "Session log" action).
- 🔒 **Read-only & isolated** — the share server binds `0.0.0.0:<port>` on its own; it exposes nothing but `GET /s/<token>`. No RPC, no writes, no session reads on view.
- 🧊 **Frozen snapshot** — the transcript *and* session stats are captured at share time; later edits or compactions never change an already-shared page.
- 🔑 **Revocable + optional expiry** — 128-bit random tokens; stop sharing anytime, or pick a 1h / 24h / 7d expiry.
- 📝 **Markdown transcript** — user & assistant messages are Markdown-rendered (safe: raw HTML is escaped, `javascript:` URLs are blocked).
- 🪗 **Readable** — long messages auto-fold behind a preview; consecutive tool calls collapse into one "🛠 tool calls" group.
- 📊 **Session stats header** — turns, steps, wall-clock duration, tool-call time, cache hits, input/output tokens, and current context occupancy with a per-category composition bar.
- 🌗 **Dark & light theme** — the share page follows `prefers-color-scheme`.
- 💾 **Persists across restarts** — shares are stored in `~/.dsh/dsh-share.json`.
- 📡 **Smart LAN

@zljr/dsh-share README · How it works：| Half | Runs in | Role |
|------|---------|------|
| Host (`src/host`) | Node (harness process) | Folds the session event log into a transcript + stats, stores the frozen snapshot, and serves it over a separate `node:http` server at `/s/<token>`. Also exposes a `/dsh-share` RPC (`create` / `revoke` / `list`). |
| Client (`src/client`) | Browser | Registers the **Share** button in `conversation.session.header.utilities` and renders the dialog (expiry picker, copy / revoke / open). |

@zljr/dsh-share README · How it works：Token estimation for the context composition reuses the harness's own fixed-density heuristic (~4 chars ≈ 1 token), matching [`dsh-context`](https://github.com/bowenliang123/dsh-context).

@zljr/dsh-share README · From npm：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @zljr/dsh-share
dsh --profile web
```

That's it — the published package ships the built `lib/`, so end users never need a build step.

@zljr/dsh-share README · Configuration：Environment variables (or a config object supplied via `cordis.patch.yml`):

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `DSH_SHARE_HOST` | `0.0.0.0` | Bind address of the read-only share server. |
| `DSH_SHARE_PORT` | `3081` | Port of the share server. |

> On Windows, the first `0.0.0.0` listen may trigger a firewall prompt — allow it so other devices can reach the link.

@zljr/dsh-share README · Security model：- The **main harness stays loopback-only**; only the read-only share surface is reachable from the LAN.
- Share tokens are **128-bit random** (unguessable) and can be **revoked** or set to **expire**.
- The share page contains **no JavaScript** and **no external assets**; message text is Markdown-rendered with raw HTML escaped and dangerous URLs rejected.
- The snapshot is **frozen** — it is not a live view of the session, and it is never re-read from the session store after creation.

@zljr/dsh-share README · Development：```sh

pnpm build       # bundle host (lib/index.js) + client (lib/client.js)
pnpm test        # typecheck + host/client functional tests
pnpm typecheck   # tsc --noEmit only
